messages:
maria: Heads-up — opened a docs PR to clarify audit log scope + scrub policy for tenant data. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321 :eyes:

maria: Problem we hit in the SDK snippet is ambiguity around what we mean by "scope" vs "visibility" when creating audit events. I added an example but want legal/devops sign-off before merging.

alex: Taking a look now. Quick question — are we standardizing on `tenant_id` being present for all tenant-scoped events, or only when the event is user-initiated?

maria: Good Q. Intent is: `tenant_id` should be set for any event that contains tenant-identifying info or could be used to reconstruct tenant activity. Non-tenant system events should omit it. Wording in the PR: "Include tenant_id for tenant-scoped audit events; omit for global system events."

devon: From an implementation POV, we should show a code snippet. I added this example in the PR body:

```python
# SDK usage: create an audit event with tenant scope
audit.log_event(
    action="dataset.accessed",
    scope="tenant",
    tenant_id="tenant_123",
    metadata={"resource": "dataset-abc"}
)
```

chris: Looks fine. Can we also include the scrub policy example for data that should never be logged (PII)? Suggest a short block like:

```text
Scrub rule: remove fields matching regex /email|ssn|credit_card/ and replace with "<redacted>" before storing audit payloads.
```

maria: Yup — added that. Sarah, could you confirm the phrasing about retention TTLs? I wrote: "Audit logs are retained per the customer's retention settings; default retention for tenant-scoped events is 365 days unless overridden by policy."

sarah-legal: Quick note — "per the customer's retention settings" is fine, but avoid implying automatic overrides without consent. Suggest: "Retention defaults to 365 days for tenant-scoped events; customers may shorten retention via explicit configuration." Also, replace "tenant-scoped" with "tenant-identifying" in the descriptive paragraph to reduce ambiguity.

maria: Good catch — will swap wording. Thanks.

alex: One tiny doc nit: the SDK snippet still references `scope="tenant"`. Maybe change to `scope="tenant-identifying"` to match legal's suggestion?

devon: I don't love long enum names in code, but we can document both: code uses `scope="tenant"` and paragraph clarifies it means tenant-identifying. Added a short note in the PR.

chris: Also proposing a tiny change to the audit export example (CSV headers) to include `scrubbed=true|false` column so ops know if PII was removed.

maria: Nice. Added CSV header example and updated the sample export line: `timestamp, action, tenant_id, scrubbed, metadata`

docs-bot: Reminder — please add a `docs/CHANGELOG.md` entry with the PR number and short summary before merging.

maria: On it. Plan: address legal wording, update code snippet note, add scrub rule, and push one more commit today. If no objections, will merge tomorrow after CI passes.

sarah-legal: No objections after wording change. Thanks for looping us in.

alex: LGTM once CI is green. :thumbsup:

devon: Will run integration test for the SDK example against staging to make sure snippet works as-is.

maria: Awesome — thanks everyone.
